text: From GitHub's docs: a fixed-IP runner has no extra fee, but it's a 'larger runner', which needs an Enterprise Cloud plan and is billed per minute (about $0.012/min for 4 cores, $0.022 for 8 per the doc mirrors I found, so roughly $0.72-$1.32 an hour, ~$17-$32 a day for a 24 h engine; not covered by free minutes). I couldn't confirm the live github.com price page or that it works on your plan. It also doesn't guarantee Novig accepts the address: a fixed address in a state Novig doesn't serve would be refused every time, while the current re-draw usually finds an accepted one within a run or two. I'd stay with the free re-draw unless refusals become constant.
